== CLI and virtualUSB downloads on Standalone

CLI and virtualUSB download links in Kobiton Portal on Standalone deployments now serve the latest public builds when the Standalone server can reach the internet. Previously, these links always served the versions included when the Standalone package was built.

*Highlights*

- With internet access, every CLI and virtualUSB download link in the Portal serves the current public build.
- Without internet access, such as in an air-gapped deployment, the download links automatically use the copy included with your Standalone installation. No error is shown and no extra step is required.
- The Standalone package now includes virtualUSB for Linux (Debian-based and Red Hat-based), so these downloads also work without internet access.
- If no download source is available, Kobiton Portal shows a download-failed message instead of opening a blank tab.

*Availability*

Standalone/On-Prem deployments only. Cloud download behavior is unchanged.
